title: The Vow of Rosewater Lane
author: D. M. Vane
blurb: Tamsin Almeida, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the festival ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
